review_evidence: The repository is mixed: LeanTool/Basic.lean implements sampling/metaprogramming commands, LeanTool/CheckFalse.lean implements an admitting debugging tactic, and lakefile.lean is package configuration.
examples/pabc_claude.lean is a substantial independent number-theory proof development (real powers, divisor function/factorization bounds and related lemmas) and remains searchable.
LeanTool.lean only aggregates the two tooling modules and has no independent formal statement.

rules.content_invariant: Basic owns sample-printing/#samplenl metaprogramming; CheckFalse owns a tactic that attempts the negated goal and otherwise inserts sorry; the root only imports those modules; lakefile only configures Hammer/mathlib and the library. The independent mathematical example remains retained.
evidence: Complete contents of all four selected files inspected; the retained examples/pabc_claude.lean was also inspected and contains many genuine lemmas/theorems.
rules.rationale: These exact files implement proof-debugging/metaprogramming tooling or Lake configuration rather than mathematical prior art.

summary: Reviewed LeanTool; the substantive pabc number-theory proof file remains searchable while the metaprogramming/debugging tool implementation and build wrapper are excluded.
